description.value: A within-subject fMRI study investigated changes in neural inhibitory-control responses to high- and low-energy food cues before and after Roux-en-Y gastric bypass surgery in morbidly obese patients.

value: we hypothesized that participants would be better able to suppress responses to high-energy items after RYGB surgery, as reflected in changes in neural responses related to inhibitory control, while behavioural and neural responses to low-energy items would remain similar.

description.value: A 2 × 2 × 2 within-subject design with time point, stimulus and task instruction factors; participants were scanned before and after RYGB surgery.
